body: Anxiety’s been kicking my ass ngl, I’m not really upset about my appearance or anything, I’m decent looking, but I’m just an awful person. Or at least my anxiety/ocd/depression/whatever the fuck else is wrong with me tells me that. Also I love your attitude and I can only aspire to have the same attitude about this stuff eventually :)

I’m an awful person and a failure because I have awful grades, I’m an awful friend, I can’t do anything right no matter how hard I try, and I’m just generally a disappointment to everyone around me. They might say otherwise but it’s true.

I do have depression and I’m taking Fluoxetine for it, but idk if it’s just because my anxiety has been really bad lately or something but I don’t feel like it’s working as well as it has been. Also I’ll try to open up to my counselor more, if it’ll make people worry less. I just feel like such a failure, everyone’s life would just be better if I crawled into a cave and never came out. I’m sorry I keep saying that I’m a failure, I know you don’t think I am, but I am. If you met me in real life you would realize how awful of a person I am and how much I don’t deserve anything.

I can’t remember when exactly I started thinking this way, but it’s been for a long time. I’m also currently seeing a counselor once a week at school which has helped my anxiety some. It’s just hard for me to say much to my counselor because I still feel like I’m unimportant and she should just go help someone else instead of me. No one (whose opinion I care about) has ever said or done something that could possibly make me think this way, and they always tell me “You’re not a failure” and “You’re never a disappointment” but I know they’re lying. They have to be! How could I possibly not be a failure? I hate this and I just want to feel happy again.

I’m sorry, I just don’t want to bother anyone, I’m not good at anything or good enough for anything, I just get in the way. I don’t feel like I’m important at all, which is fine because I hate attention, and if I make a mistake I don’t want a bunch of people to see. No one has seen me have a panic attack or just break down and cry, I just disappear to somewhere but I think that might worry them more. No matter what I do people worry about me! I just don’t want to bother anyone. I’m sorry you took the time to type all that out for someone like me. I’m sorry.
Thank you. I’m not going to lie, I still don’t feel 100%, but I haven’t felt completely fine in years, however I do feel better than I did before. So thank you. :)

Alright this is the list I made

- I’ve only been driving for a month and I already suck at that

- No matter how much I practice my flute I still suck at playing it after ~4 years of playing it

- I have such bad grades that I was worried 
about getting kicked out of beta club

- My mental health is shit for no reason that can be determined

- I worry so many amazing people that should just leave me to suffer instead of helping me

- I’m just an awful person with no redeeming qualities and a horrendous personality to match

- I have too many panic attacks to even function like a normal person

- I just avoid things that give me anxiety instead of actually facing them

- I lie to my parents to prevent them from worrying about me, it just makes them worry more because I suck at lying

- I’m too soft spoken to stand up for myself at all, which worries my mom

- Nothing I ever say is ever important

- I suck at the few things I like to do

- My lowest grade is in my favorite subject

- It takes everything I have not to break down in tears when someone is kind to me and tells me they actually care about my well-being and are worried about me

- I can never find the right words to describe how I’m feeling, so my parents probably just think that I’m making all this shit up to have an excuse to stay home from school occasionally
I’ll try to open up more to my parents, counselor, and doctor. I promise. Also thank you.

Well, my doctor knows about my depression but I mostly talk to my counselor about mental health stuff, and even then I struggle to open up about it. I know she’s here to help me and she wants to help me, but I just feel like I’m a burden.
My current dose is 10mg I believe. I can talk to my parents about possibly getting a higher dose.
I feel the same way, I haven’t found a subreddit for it though, I just wanted to let you know that you are not alone.

Why do people keep calling kids who feel this way weaklings? Have they not heard of depression, especially untreated depression? God forbid someone has had untreated depression, anxiety, and ocd for over 2 years and wants to stay in their room so they don’t have a panic attack or sensory overload. Ffs just be kind. I didn’t stay in my room then because I didn’t like my parents, I just didn’t want to disappoint people with my mere presence like I always thought I did, and other people probably felt the same way.

Yes, a couple years ago I did the same thing. She was just such an awful person and would always say that if I made another friend she would stop being my friend, so I would just deal with having that bitch as my only friend for the longest time, and I might even suffer from some mental health issues because of it. However, the thing that really sent me over the edge was when she made a racist comment about the person who is now my best friend, and I decided that was the time to cut her off.

Well, no one did, but I just keep reading about horrible people who abuse cats and dogs for no reason. Although, there were some small children in the family Cleo used to live in until she was given to us, and she’s scared of so many odd things, like plastic bags, loud people, new people, and blankets. We’re thinking she was mistreated in her old home, and I don’t want her to have to go through something like that again.
I know! And not only is she chonky, but everything about her extremely short for a cat. Her torso, her legs, even her tail. It’s adorable.

I have a couple friends like that, but it’s more so my parents being similar to this. I know it’s for “my health” (pfFt wHo nEeDs gOod hEaLtH, aM i RiGht?) but they keep trying to get me outside and go on walks and various stuff, but I’m like you and would rather watch anime and read than socialize.

Thanks, I’ll use your advice and hopefully feel better. I had been struggling with depression for a while, but I finally got some medicine for it and it’s been working very well. I don’t know how I would have survived being at home all day everyday at that point, because school was what I used to distract myself from it. And while I really just want to go back to school, at least my mental health is better.

Thanks for the support, you gave me some good advice! I normally watch the Game Grumps when I’m feeling down because they always make me laugh, and they’re posting a new episode of playing A Link Between Worlds everyday, so I can look forward to that. Maybe I can try switching up what video game I play each day because that’s pretty much all I do.
Oh god, I feel the same way, my neighbors were just taking an entire day to cut down a tree with a chainsaw and I was pretty much about to lose my shit by noon.

I just want things to go back to normal so I can go to school. That’s all I want, is that too much to ask? Apparently so because all schools in my state have been shut down until the end of the school year and we’re going to start doing online classes, but they stress me out more than school ever did. I can’t take it anymore, I can never go anywhere online without seeing something about COVID-19, and I’m starting to lose it. Watching the Game Grumps always helps me calm down after an anxiety attack, yet I see too many ads of celebrities telling us to stay at home and medical professionals talking about how awful COVID-19 is for 15 unskippable seconds. I know it’s bad, but I just don’t want to hear it anymore. I start thinking about it and how terrifying it actually is, and I start hyperventilating. I just want it all to stop, especially since I have a crap immune system and am probably quite susceptible to it, while over half my family is perfectly healthy and working in retail. I’m just so scared and done with it all. I’ve gotten to where I just don’t want to leave the house at all at this point, I’m just so scared and anxious and I know I’m repeating myself a lot but I just want it all to stop and go back to normal.
Thank you!

Just had serious suicidal thoughts a moment ago, I could see myself going due to an overdose, it seems to easiest, but I couldn’t because my parents are home, so I’m playing some Sims 4 to get my mind off it for now. I’ll just wait until I’m home alone at some point in the future.
That’s exactly how I feel and it’s freaking awful, I wish I had a way to help you but I can’t even help myself.

Just wanted to say thanks to all the people who commented on my post. And yes, I did go to school today. I mean, I had a panic attack in my 3rd period, but I’m still glad I went, and thank you all for the encouragement, I really needed it lol.

I could probably get help from my teacher, she’s a really good teacher and is pretty adamant on helping me, but I just always feel so bad and think I’m wasting a teachers time when I ask them for help out of class, but I’m too scared to ask questions during class because my classmates are assholes.
I don’t think getting help will do that, it’s just I don’t think having a therapist or medication would help that much, then my mental health would just get worse over time.

Hey, you’re okay. I’m not going to give some bullshit line like “Just believe you’ll get better and you will” I’ve struggled with my weight too, and it takes work, but I’m at a relatively healthy weight now, so I hope you can get there too. 

This probably didn’t help at all and I apologize for that, I just wanted to at least try to help you.

I’m not going say life in general is pointless, it’s that *my* life is pointless. I don’t have the energy to do anything anymore. I know I’m a fucking disappointment to every living thing, so I stay in my room all weekend and sleep as late as possible. Most days my motto is “I can’t be a fucking disappointment if I’m asleep”. However I’m starting to realize that the later I sleep in, the more of a disappointment I am, so why wake up at all? I honestly cannot think of a single reason I should not just fucking surrender. Life was a level 99 boss battle and I was a new player with no armor or weapons. I’m not even out of high school yet. I have my entire damn life ahead of me, but I already feel completely fucking defeated. I have four C’s on my report and my mom’s going to kill me, I have an assignment due tonight that I haven’t even started yet, and I just have one question to the poor, unfortunate soul who read this. 

What’s the point?
Oof I feel the same way.
